title: Admin asks the assistant "Who earns the most in Tech in India?"
trigger: Type the question in the composer on /assistant (new conversation) and press Enter
traceBase: master 9236ac4, re-checked after the merge of master with AI Task 05 (feat/architecture-flows)

evidence.source: Read-only browse of http://localhost:3224/admin/ai-traces as Meera Iyer (Admin HR), 2026-11-17. No messages sent, no review, no delete.
observedSteps: Step 1 of 5: User prompt ("Who earns the most?")
Step 3 of 5: Tool call 1: get_top_compensated_employees Succeeded (requested { metric: ANNUAL_BASE, currency: null, limit: 1, comparisonCurrency: USD })
evidence.note: The evaluator lane holds no trace for the exact question "…in Tech in India?" and sending one was not allowed, so the closest real trace (same tool, same 2-model/1-tool shape, model gpt-6-luna, status COMPLETED, 6.41 s) confirms the order: model call → tool attempt and outcome → model call → final. Trace 8cf829cd-8576-4953-b26f-69118e4af51f shows the parallel case (one model call requesting two tools, both recorded before model call 2). Re-checked after AI Task 05: prompt version is now assistant-instructions-v2 (PROMPT_VERSION, assistant-service.ts:45). The evidence trace predates Task 05, so its recorded prompt version may be v1; the step order is unchanged by Task 05.

nodes.label: Enter in composer
nodes.does: Trims the draft, blocks empty or >2,000-character text, clears the draft, and starts a submission.

nodes.label: run(): key + transition
nodes.does: Shows the pending user message, creates the Idempotency-Key (crypto.randomUUID via newKey), and calls the Server Action inside a transition.

nodes.label: sendConversationMessage
nodes.does: Untrusted entry point: validates { conversationId|null, content, idempotencyKey, retryOfTraceId? }, reads the session cookie, and calls Express.

nodes.label: POST /assistant/conversations
nodes.does: requireAuth, 1 kB JSON parser, then conversations.create(principal); 201 AssistantConversationResponse.

nodes.label: ai_conversations
nodes.does: New conversation row owned by the HR user.

nodes.label: sendAssistantConversationMessage
nodes.does: POST …/messages with Authorization: Bearer, the Idempotency-Key header, one message only, the assistant timeout, and isAssistantTurnResponse as validator.

nodes.label: requireAuth
nodes.does: Reloads the principal (session, status, role, scopes) from MySQL for this request; failure is 401.

nodes.label: assistantRequestLimiter
nodes.does: 20 message submissions per HR user per 15 minutes; over the limit is 429 with Retry-After.

nodes.label: POST …/messages
nodes.does: 12 kB parser; requires an Idempotency-Key matching ASSISTANT_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY; parses AssistantMessageRequest; calls conversations.submit.

nodes.label: conversations.submit
nodes.does: Owns the turn: loads the owned conversation (store.readConversation, else 404), idempotency, history, trace creation, runTurn, finalisation; maps failures to public errors.

nodes.label: findTraceByIdempotency
nodes.does: Looks up a trace in this conversation with the same Idempotency-Key (SELECT ai_traces ⋈ ai_messages); a hit replays instead of running a new turn.

nodes.label: selectHistory
nodes.does: Bounded server-side history: up to 4 recent COMPLETED turns and 16,000 characters, dropping turns the caller's current scope no longer covers; the browser's history is never used.

nodes.label: createTrace
nodes.does: One transaction: STARTED trace (prompt version assistant-instructions-v2 and its hash, model, actor scope snapshot, exact model messages, key + command hash) and the user message.
nodes.failClosed: TRACE_CREATE: if this write fails the API returns 503 TRACE_UNAVAILABLE and OpenAI is never called; a reused key with different content is 409 DUPLICATE_OPERATION.

nodes.label: ai_traces
nodes.does: The trace row, status STARTED.

nodes.label: ai_messages
nodes.does: The USER message of this turn (the ASSISTANT message is inserted the same way in finishTrace).

nodes.label: assistant.runTurn
nodes.does: The tool loop with a turn deadline: record attempt → call model → record outcome → for each tool: record attempt → validate/run → record outcome → next model call.
nodes.failClosed: No model configured: TurnFailure(MODEL_CALL, not_configured) before any provider or tool call; the turn is finalised FAILED.

nodes.label: ai_model_calls (attempt)
nodes.does: startModelCall: the exact model input (instructions, messages, earlier exchanges) and tool schemas, before the provider call.
nodes.failClosed: MODEL_TRACE_WRITE: persist() throws TurnFailure, so no unrecorded provider call is made.

nodes.label: OpenAI adapter session.next
nodes.does: Appends tool outputs to the replayed input and calls the Responses API (store: false, tool_choice auto, parallel tool calls, no SDK retries).

nodes.label: OpenAI Responses API
nodes.does: The language model: returns either function_call items (tool decisions) or answer text, plus token usage.

nodes.label: ai_model_calls (outcome)
nodes.does: finishModelCall: SUCCEEDED with output text, tool decisions (scrubbed JSON arguments), tokens, latency, provider request ID — or FAILED with a safe category.
nodes.failClosed: MODEL_TRACE_WRITE: if the outcome cannot be saved, the reply's text and tool decisions are never used.

nodes.label: ai_tool_calls (attempt)
nodes.does: startToolCall: tool name, provider call ID, requested arguments; only after the parent model call is SUCCEEDED.
nodes.failClosed: TOOL_TRACE_WRITE: the tool is not validated or run without this row.

nodes.label: tools.run → runTyped (validation)
nodes.does: Unknown name → REJECTED UNKNOWN_TOOL; TOOL_INPUT_SCHEMAS[name].safeParse(args) fails → REJECTED INVALID_ARGUMENTS; otherwise calls the handler with the server principal.

nodes.label: get_top_compensated_employees
nodes.does: Ranks by { metric, currency, limit } (no department or country argument exists), checks every row with assertPermitted, builds an employee_list card, and adds limitations through withScope (scopeLimitation for Scoped HR).

nodes.label: insights.topCompensated
nodes.does: Read-only ranking SQL over currently working employees; native currency, or USD equivalent via the saved rate.
nodes.scopeRule: scopeCondition(principal) in the WHERE clause, the same rule as the directory: ADMIN sees all; SCOPED only their countries AND departments. The model cannot pass identity or scope.

nodes.label: employees ⋈ job_titles ⋈ departments
nodes.does: Employees in scope, joined to job titles and departments (FROM_EMPLOYEES).

nodes.label: compensation_records
nodes.does: SELECTED_COMPENSATION LATERAL join (used by topCompensated at compensation-insights.ts:127): the selected record per employee, which the ranking orders by base or cash.

nodes.label: scopeLimitation
nodes.does: Fixed coverage statement from the principal's current scope, prepended to ranking, summary, and recent-change limitations. Admin HR: null (nothing added).
nodes.scopeRule: Scoped HR results always carry 'Covers only employees in your access: …' so a scoped figure is never presented as company-wide; for this Admin flow it returns null.

nodes.label: ai_tool_calls (outcome)
nodes.does: finishToolCall: SUCCEEDED with the complete structured result, or REJECTED with validation errors, or FAILED with a safe category; duration.
nodes.failClosed: TOOL_TRACE_WRITE: cards are not used and the next model call is not made until this outcome is saved.

nodes.label: finishTrace
nodes.does: One transaction: ASSISTANT message with the final response, then the trace COMPLETED with totals summed from its model and tool calls.
nodes.failClosed: FINAL_TRACE_WRITE: if this fails the trace is marked FAILED and the API returns 503; the answer is never returned unrecorded.

nodes.label: ai_traces (final)
nodes.does: Terminal status, final response, duration, token totals, model and tool call counts.

nodes.label: AssistantTurnResponse.parse
nodes.does: Validated turn response: answer, toolCalls, cards, limitations, trace and sequence IDs, withheld.

nodes.label: isAssistantTurnResponse (Ajv)
nodes.does: The Next server rejects any response that breaks the generated contract (shown as an unconfirmed send).

nodes.label: /assistant/[id] Server Component
nodes.does: After router.replace, loads the saved conversation (GET …/conversations/{id}) and the list; 404 for unknown or unowned IDs.

nodes.label: buildThread
nodes.does: Orders messages by sequence, attaches turn states, and re-filters cards to the current scope (filterCardsToScope).

nodes.label: AnswerView + cards
nodes.does: Client component: model text as plain text, tool activity, AssistantCardView cards in native currency with rate context, limitations.

edges.payload: SELECT ai_traces ⋈ ai_messages → existing trace | null

persist(MODEL_TRACE_WRITE, recorder.startModelCall) — model call 1

edges.payload: { model, instructions, input, tools, tool_choice: auto }

edges.label: Response: function_call get_top_compensated_employees
edges.payload: { call_id, name, arguments: { metric, currency, limit } }, usage

decideTool → tools.run(name, args, { principal, asOf, now })
handlers.get_top_compensated_employees(parsed.data, context)

LEFT JOIN LATERAL (… FROM compensation_records c …) AS sc
persist(TOOL_TRACE_WRITE, recorder.finishToolCall) — SUCCEEDED with complete result

UPDATE ai_traces SET status = COMPLETED, totals …
action returns { ok, conversationId } → router.replace(/assistant/{id}) → GET /api/v1/assistant/conversations/{id}

alternatives.label: Model call fails or times out
alternatives.condition: responses.create throws (timeout, rate limit, provider error, invalid response)
alternatives.result: finishModelCall records FAILED with a safe category; TurnFailure(MODEL_CALL) → failTrace marks the trace FAILED; the API returns 502 MODEL_PROVIDER_FAILED; the UI shows the recorded failed turn with Retry (new key, retryOfTraceId).

alternatives.label: Rejected tool call
alternatives.condition: unknown tool name or arguments fail TOOL_INPUT_SCHEMAS (for example a department argument the tool does not have)
alternatives.result: The tool never runs; ai_tool_calls is finished REJECTED with the validation errors, and the error text goes back to the model as the tool output for the next model call.

alternatives.label: Same Idempotency-Key again
alternatives.condition: Send again after an unconfirmed send reuses the key with the same content
alternatives.result: No new trace and no model call: the stored result is returned with Idempotency-Replayed: true (or 409 ASSISTANT_TURN_IN_PROGRESS while it still runs; different content with the same key is 409 DUPLICATE_OPERATION).

notes: Observability writes: steps 4, 12, 13, 14, 16, 20, 21, 28, 29, 33, 34, 35, 36. Every model and tool step is written before (attempt) and after (outcome) it runs.

Fail-closed points: createTrace (TRACE_CREATE), every persist(MODEL_TRACE_WRITE | TOOL_TRACE_WRITE) in runTurn, and finishTrace (FINAL_TRACE_WRITE). A failed write stops the turn; nothing unrecorded runs or is returned.
Model call 2 reuses the same nodes (orders 29–33); the arrows at those orders are the second model call.

Product finding: no assistant tool accepts a department or country, so "in Tech in India" cannot be passed as a filter. The model can only restrict by currency (INR) or rank everyone; the Admin's scope is ALL. This is how the code behaves today, not an invented step.

Secrets: a key-based scrubber replaces secret-named fields (authorization, cookie, password, token, API key, database URL, reasoning) before persistence; the provider key and the JWT are not part of any recorded input.
AI Task 05: every ranking, summary, and recent-change tool result for Scoped HR now starts its limitations with scopeLimitation's fixed coverage statement; Admin HR gets none.
